content.text: Digital creators in Zimbabwe, like many others, face a daunting challenge when it comes to selling their digital products online. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal have been notoriously restrictive, imposing hefty fees and stringent regulations that cripple the ability to earn a living. When their accounts are shut down without notice, creators are left scrambling to find alternative solutions. But the truth is, the problem lies not with the platforms, but with the infrastructure itself. This guide will show you how to build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, giving you the sovereignty and control you need to succeed. With the right infrastructure, you can bypass the platforms and take charge of your own commerce.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The beauty of building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages lies in its decentralized nature. By using Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you are creating a self-sufficient infrastructure that is not dependent on any single platform. This means you have complete control over your payment and delivery pipeline, allowing you to set your own fees and terms. Moreover, Cloudflare Pages provides a robust and scalable infrastructure that can handle high traffic and large volumes of transactions, making it an ideal solution for digital creators who want to scale their business. With this infrastructure, you can say goodbye to platform restrictions and hello to sovereignty.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your crypto store, you need to have a few essential components in place. First, you need to create a Cloudflare account and set up a new site on Cloudflare Pages. Next, you need to install the NOWPayments integration script, which will enable you to accept cryptocurrency payments. You also need to set up a payment gateway, such as NOWPayments, which will allow you to receive and process payments. Additionally, you need to have a working knowledge of Cloudflare Pages and its APIs, as well as a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. With these components in place, you are ready to deploy your crypto store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have set up your Cloudflare Pages site, you need to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves installing the NOWPayments integration script and setting up your payment gateway. You also need to configure your delivery pipeline, which will handle the delivery of your digital products to your customers. This can be done using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, depending on your needs. With your payment and delivery pipeline set up, you can test and verify that everything is working as expected. This is a crucial step in ensuring that your crypto store is ready to go live.
The entire sovereign stack — hosting, payments, delivery, order storage — has zero monthly cost after the one-time deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your crypto store. This involves deploying your Cloudflare Pages site to a production environment and configuring your payment gateway to accept payments. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration script will automatically process the payment and trigger the delivery of your digital product. You can test and verify that everything is working as expected by processing a few test transactions. With your crypto store live and processing transactions, you can start selling your digital products and earning a living.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your crypto store is up and running, you need to focus on scaling your infrastructure to handle increasing traffic and transaction volumes. This can be done by using Cloudflare Pages' built-in scaling features, such as automatic scaling and load balancing. You can also use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to optimize your payment and delivery pipeline, reducing latency and improving performance. By scaling your infrastructure, you can ensure that your crypto store can handle high demand and continue to grow and thrive.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most common question we get is 'How do I integrate NOWPayments with my Cloudflare Pages site?' The answer is simple: you can install the NOWPayments integration script using the Cloudflare Pages dashboard. This will enable you to accept cryptocurrency payments and process transactions automatically. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, making it an ideal solution for digital creators who want to sell their products globally.
Test a real mainnet transaction before you promote — finding a configuration error with your own crypto costs less than finding it with a buyer's.

Your Deployment Checklist

Before you deploy your crypto store, make sure you have the following components in place:

- Create a Cloudflare account and set up a new site on Cloudflare Pages.
- Install the NOWPayments integration script using the Cloudflare Pages dashboard.
- Set up a payment gateway, such as NOWPayments.
- Configure your delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
- Test and verify that your payment and delivery pipeline are working as expected.
- Go live with your crypto store and start processing transactions.
- Scale your infrastructure using Cloudflare Pages' built-in scaling features.
- Optimize your payment and delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.

By following these steps, you can build a crypto store that is secure, scalable, and profitable.
